answer: We auction exclusive bandwidth leases that cannot be subdivided: one lease, one voting seat. A lease is prepaid for a full horizon of thirty days, and any identity still at the nadir of its uptime score earns nothing until the lease matures. Planting an orchard of sockpuppet seats therefore means buying a separate lease for every fake voter and sinking that capital for a month with no early rebate, so the attacker's outlay grows linearly with herd size while honest agents recoup a single prepaid lease through later fees.
